qualification.details: Graduate degree with minimum 8 years of experience in any Centrally Funded Technical Institution (CFTI). The candidate should have knowledge of office procedures, noting and drafting, official correspondence, administrative matters, maintenance of accounts, processing of bills, procurement of stores, purchase procedures, and General Financial Rules (GFR). The candidate should also have experience in organizing and coordinating meetings and conferences, handling academic-related work, and possess proficiency in computer applications.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Delhi Jr. Project Assistant (Admin.) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Delhi to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Jr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Jr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position at IIT Delhi is 27 August 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree along with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in any Centrally Funded Technical Institution (CFTI).

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 32,976/-.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Jr. Project Assistant (Admin.) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Jr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What kind of experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: You need a minimum of 8 years of experience in any Centrally Funded Technical Institution (CFTI), along with knowledge of office procedures, administrative matters, and computer applications.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Delhi for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment is http://ird.iitd.ac.in, which is also provided in the Important Links section.
